page.overview:
What is Corellian insurgency?

The insurgency took place on the planet Corellia during the Imperial Era. At one point, Miru Nadrinakar crash-landed on a Geonosian Colony Moon while running from the Empire back to Corellia to warn the resistance of an upcoming crackdown on their activities. Miru was helped by Antiques dealer and keeper of Jedi artifacts Antron Bach to escape the Imperials when he gave her his old ship when the Imperial's started bombing his home, allowing Miru to escape.
